noun_definition: Workspace switcher refers to the dropdown menu in the application that allows users to select and switch between different workspaces.
all refers to the default workspace option in the workspace switcher that is automatically selected after a page refresh, overriding the user's previous selection.
Expensify refers to the web application being tested, specifically the staging environment for managing different workspaces within the platform.

Page refresh refers to the action of reloading the current webpage, which in this context causes the workspace selection to reset to the default "All" instead of retaining the user's previously selected workspace.
